BG_A_THOUSAND_CUTS_POWER.title: A Thousand Cuts

BG_AFTER_IMAGE_POWER.title: After Image
BG_AFTER_IMAGE_POWER.description: Whenever you discard one or more cards during your turn, gain [blue]{Amount}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
BG_CORPSE_EXPLOSION_POWER.title: Corpse Explosion

BG_DISTRACTION_POWER.title: Distraction
BG_DISTRACTION_POWER.description: Once per turn, when you apply [gold]Weak[/gold], [gold]Vulnerable[/gold], or [gold]Poison[/gold] to an enemy, gain [blue]{Amount}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
BG_ENVENOM_POWER.title: Envenom

BG_INFINITE_BLADES_POWER.title: Infinite Blades
BG_INFINITE_BLADES_POWER.description: At the start of your turn, gain [blue]{Amount}[/blue] [gold]{Amount:plural:Shiv|Shivs}[/gold].
BG_NOXIOUS_FUMES_POWER.title: Noxious Fumes
BG_NOXIOUS_FUMES_POWER.description: At the start of your turn, apply [blue]{Amount}[/blue] [gold]Poison[/gold] to an enemy of your choice.
BG_NOXIOUS_FUMES_ALL_POWER.title: Noxious Fumes
BG_NOXIOUS_FUMES_ALL_POWER.description: At the start of your turn, apply [blue]{Amount}[/blue] [gold]Poison[/gold] to ALL enemies.
BG_WELL_LAID_PLANS_POWER.title: Well-Laid Plans
BG_WELL_LAID_PLANS_POWER.description: At the end of your turn, you may [gold]Retain[/gold] up to [blue]{Amount}[/blue] {Amount:plural:card|cards}.
BG_WRAITH_FORM_POWER.title: Wraith Form
BG_WRAITH_FORM_POWER.description: You can't lose more than 1 HP per round. Lasts [blue]{Amount}[/blue] more {Amount:plural:round|rounds}.
BG_BULLET_TIME_POWER.title: Bullet Time
BG_BULLET_TIME_POWER.description: Cards that were in your hand cost 0 this turn.
